#: Strings of MO2 ApI Bridge, section "lifecycle". Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the plugin: keep them spelled exactly, or the line is shown raw. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored. To add a language, copy the folder next to this one and translate the files inside; the plugin reads whatever folders it finds, and a section may be added as a new file without touching the others.
dialog.startFailed:
The bridge did NOT start.

%(error)s

Details: %(log)s
dialog.stuck:
MO2 still considers a run active:
%(run)s

While that holds, the bridge refuses to change the mod setup. If the MO2 window is already unlocked and nothing is running, the bookkeeping can be reset.
init.loaded: plugin loaded, waiting for the user interface
start.otherPort: port %(wanted)s was taken - most likely by a second MO2 instance; listening on %(port)s instead, token in %(token)s
